name: Impervious Melody
body:
Requirement: Perform 17 ranks

Base effect: All allies within 30 feet gain a +1 morale bonus to AC, CMB, and all saving throws. The bonus becomes 1 point higher at 5th level and every 5 level thereafter (to a maximum of +5 at 20th level).

Refrain

You channel a spark of immortality in your allies, making them more resistant until the end of your next turn.

Weak Refrain: allies within 30 feet gain DR 3/–.

Intermediate Refrain: allies within 30 feet gain DR 5/– and SR 20.

Strong refrain: allies within 30 feet gain DR 10/– and SR equal to 7 + your siren level.
